ukkā.cp: fem. 1. a torch; 2. a meteor; 3. forge of a smith.
ukkā.p: [Usa+ka] (thī) CL=7 [Usa dāhe, usatīti ukkā. Ṇvādi. 15.uca+ka. Nīti, dhā. 223.] (1) Flaming torch. A bundle of flaming torches. (2) Crucible or melting pot. (3) Blacksmith's forge. (4) The wind speed. (Arising light or radiance due to colliding each wind speed). (5) Crucibles of goldsmiths. See - Ukkāmukha.
